abilities.name: Effort
abilities.description: Increase the minimum number rolled for this ability by 3.

abilities.name: Expert Combatant
abilities.description: You are trained in a specific weapon attack of your choice, such as swords, axes, or bows; or in a broader category of attacks such as light bashing weapons, light bladed weapons, light ranged weapons, medium bashing weapons, medium bladed weapons, medium ranged weapons, and so on.

abilities.name: Push Implant
abilities.description: After attacking, you can activate a combat implant to make an additional attack as an extra action on your turn. Doing this inflicts a moderate wound on yourself. Enabler.

system.description:

Genre: Science Fiction. Subgenre: Space Opera. Primary Pools: might, speed.
